family: The single total family fixed in field.md and used in proof.md: f_0=0; for n>=1 let k be the least prime strictly above 2*n^(3/5), r=ceil(n/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); build the field F_(2^k) by the one fixed deterministic algorithm of field.md (Berlekamp factoring, cyclotomic nonresidue chain, irreducible X^k-alpha, trace element); pad x with zeros into r blocks, interpret each block in F_(2^k) (first bit = constant coefficient), set y_i=phi_i(x)^(2^(i+1)-1), and output the constant coefficient of Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r).
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, hence one NP language with empty witnesses, at actual input length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model: C_B2(f_n) >= (7/2)n - (29757/1000)*n^(4/5) - 7 for every integer n >= 10^20, and therefore liminf C_B2(f_n)/n >= 7/2.
